issue.title: improve Mockito.mockingDetails API
issue.body:
In order to make the API cleaner & expose useful information:
1. MockingDetails.getInvocations() throws meaningful exception when passed object is not a mock and documents this behavior
2. getMockedType() and getExtraInterfaces() are replaced with getMockCreationSettings() that returns MockCreationSettings instance.
